method: Executed actual production renderer and canonical runtime in a VM with a command-recording canvas.
Compared every resting layer point, identity, opacity, width and draw mode, then compared actual canvas path commands and transforms.
Read pixel opacity from the accepted PNG source sheets without modifying them. Passed pixel-backed canvas objects to the renderer so measured-raster fitting runs.
Forced raster rest only for fitting measurements, captured actual drawImage transforms, and independently projected source ink support through those transforms.
Checked all 1,560 directed expression pairs end on the exact canonical target paths at the 15 fps cadence and 600 ms requested transition duration.
Verified canonical source bytes against the v2 baseline, all extracted image hashes against current files, and production renderer bytes against the published preview renderer.
warnings: Canonical-mouthless faces have no speech mouth: 12_happy_09_manual, 35_sad_10_manual
limits: Canvas command equality establishes identical paths at rest, not GPU antialiasing or perceived animation quality.
Forced generated-rest dimensions diagnose blink retargeting only; production rest renders canonical source paths.
Blink intermediary silhouettes intentionally differ from the source contour. This test does not claim identical contours while blinking.
